# Sentrix

> AI-verified command-and-control platform for physical security. Sentrix is the
> first platform that lets teams without a dedicated security department deploy a
> full monitoring system themselves — a built-in recommendation engine analyzes a
> site and tells you exactly which sensors to buy, how many, and where to place
> them, before any hardware goes up.

## What Sentrix does

- Correlates camera, access-control, motion, LPR, and panic-button signals into
  single incidents instead of a wall of disconnected alerts.
- AI-verifies alerts (vision + reasoning models) before they reach a human operator.
- Generates a response plan and starts an SLA clock the moment a sensor fires.
- Scans a location's perimeter and surroundings for access risk and concealment
  before a single sensor is installed, and uses that analysis to recommend sensor
  type, count, and placement.
- Gives every incident a full investigation view: schematic, timeline, camera
  feed, and investigator notes.
- Works across retail, banking and finance, warehouse and logistics, corporate
  offices, and general multi-location technology deployments.
- Provider-agnostic AI layer — works with cloud models or local/on-prem models
  (e.g. Ollama) for sites that need data to stay on-site.
